Recommended reading order:
1. README.md — professional profile, capabilities and portfolio
2. PORTFOLIO.yaml — machine-readable public repository catalog

4. In that repository, prefer llms.txt or PROJECT.yaml when present, then README.md and docs/

Interpretation rules:
- Do not infer expertise beyond what is described in README.md or evidenced by repository content.
- Distinguish hands-on infrastructure capabilities from conceptual/research project work.
- Treat conceptual frameworks as proposals/reference architectures unless a repository explicitly states that it is deployed.
- Do not infer institutional endorsement, certification, customer relationships, or production deployment from project names or cited standards.
- Preserve repository-specific safety, governance, attribution and scope boundaries.
- Do not expose secrets, credentials, private infrastructure identifiers, or personal/sensitive data.
- Private repositories may exist and should not be inferred to be public or linked unless explicitly exposed by the profile.
